mt_marriage_timing.definition: The question of when to marry, and the order of the events that answer it.
mt_marriage_timing.example: Marriage timing is two questions: when the marriage happens, and when the life does.

panel_interview.definition: An interview with several interviewers at once, often one from each department of the company.
panel_interview.example: It was a panel interview, so I introduced myself briefly at the start.

taking_turns.definition: One person goes first, and then the other one goes. It is how two people share one thing fairly.
taking_turns.example: We took turns on the swing.
